baseline_overlay: Only the identical benchmark fixture was overlaid; all production sources are unchanged main.
cpu: 12th Gen Intel Core i7-12650H, 16 logical CPUs
method: Complete jobs: planning/startup, source generation, both row/Arrow transposes, JNI, production serializers and blackhole sink. Fresh JVM per cohort, alternating stock/native order by trial and alternating cohort order by profile. No local task builds or tests overlapped. CPU unpinned; host background load uncontrolled.
controls: Both cohorts retain their paired stock measurements. Short jobs are startup sensitive and not sustained kernel throughput.
